prompt:
Create the separate original portrait iPhone wallpaper for ROLLWAKE ARCADE. Full bleed opaque portrait with a single real tangible miniature travelling fairground scene fabricated from broad honey-buff matte paper music rolls, muted mulberry paper seams and quiet worn light wood spindles. Very dark muted blue slate ground across the first forty percent, fading to a slightly lighter slate paper yard below. Show just one convincing grouped setting: a working flat fairground platform with an arched pipe organ front left, one tall spiral paper slide behind toward the right, and two small swing boat seats on their common arm just behind the organ. Keep the scenes materially coherent with the accepted organ image. Add rows of staggered different-length rounded rectangular punched note slots across broad inward-curving paper planes, exposed tightly spiraling wound edges, warm paper grain and real depth inside holes. Warm buff forms lit with one gentle warm overhead source against dark blue slate, peaceful dusk. Light the machinery gently with no visible bulbs, solar circle or sky effects.
PHONE LAYOUT is strict. Place the complete fairground sculpture group inside the inner 58 percent of the image width and within 43 to 77 percent of its height. Left and right at least 21 percent virtually empty. Entire wide base lip, all feet, top tower point, ride extremities, and the warm part of cast shadow remain inside this group. Top 40 percent entirely low-detail dark slate. Bottom 20 percent minimal slate fading toward darker. The platform is an unobtrusive paper deck under the group, its entire lip inset and seen end to end. No horizon line, border frames, floor seam, tall rays, trees, signs, writing, branding, UI, mockup, collage, spectators, light spots or sparkles. One restrained, tactile evening scene with ample open dark space for phone utilities. Art reads clearly as one coherent group. Treat attached original organ as material reference only.
processing: Wallpaper: fit to 1290x2796 with centering [0.5, 0.5]. Artwork: fit entire original to 840px inside transparent 1024px canvas, no crop/recolour/subject edits; alpha retained.
